defined_text = {
	name = DA_LZ_GetWsRecite
	random = no
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_LZ_ws_unbuilt
		trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_built } }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_LZ_ws_ready
		trigger = { DA_LZ_rested.recite = yes }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_LZ_ws_recite_wait
		trigger = { always = yes }
	}
